hazardSensors.name: 4B M300 Slipswitch
hazardSensors.tolerance: Calibration target 100% running speed. Immediate shutdown latch at 80% nominal speed (OSHA 1910.272).
hazardSensors.purpose: Averts frictional heating and fire runaway caused by belt slippage against the driving pulley.

hazardSensors.name: 4B Binswitch Capacitance Choke Detector
hazardSensors.tolerance: Fitted flush on vertical baffle plate. 1/8" (3.18 mm) minimum clearance. Tripping immediately cuts infeed slide gate.
hazardSensors.purpose: Detects discharge blockage before grain backs up into the rotating head wheel.

hazardSensors.name: Boone / Rolfes Brass Rub Sensor Pads
hazardSensors.tolerance: Brass half-moon wear face directly monitored by embedded Type T thermocouple. Senses lateral belt wander friction.
hazardSensors.purpose: Detects belt misalignment before belt edge abrades through steel trunking wall.

faultDiagnostics.name: Back-Legging (Discharge Recirculation)
faultDiagnostics.symptom: Grain falls down down-leg trunking rather than clearing the throat; increased drive amperage and motor overheating.
faultDiagnostics.remedy: Adjust adjustable rubber deflector baffle to 1/8" (3.18 mm) nominal gap (1/4" over lap splice). Check pulley RPM.
faultDiagnostics.rootCause: Discharge baffle clearance out of spec (> 1/4" / 6.35 mm) or belt speed below 2.50 m/s.

faultDiagnostics.name: Belt Lateral Misalignment & Casing Tracking Drift
faultDiagnostics.triggerSource: Boot Take-Up Screw Asymmetry / Crown Wear
faultDiagnostics.symptom: Belt drifts towards casing wall; Boone/Rolfes brass rub sensors detect frictional heat spike (> 60°C).
faultDiagnostics.remedy: Perform twin screw take-up adjustment with equal turns L/R under LOTO. Verify head pulley 391 mm camber.
faultDiagnostics.rootCause: Unequal tension screw torque or uneven bucket bolt clamping across antistatic belt carcass.

faultDiagnostics.name: Pulley Slippage & Frictional Overheating
faultDiagnostics.triggerSource: Drive Pulley Face / Insufficient Belt Slack Take-Up
faultDiagnostics.symptom: 4B M300 Slipswitch detects speed differential > 20%; drive motor draws excess current with reduced conveying lift.
faultDiagnostics.remedy: Inspect take-up screw tensioners. Verify crowned head pulley lagging wear. Check drive belt deflection (Span/64).
faultDiagnostics.rootCause: Material choke in boot sump or drive belt slack exceeding span/64 tolerance limit.

parts.description: The entire housing is split and can be removed for inspection, belt splicing, and pulley maintenance without disturbing the vertical casing legs.
parts.safetyNotice: Ensure drive motor is locked out before hood removal. Guard against accidental belt runback.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Split flange gasket compression: 2.0 mm uniform seal. Fasteners torqued to 35 Nm.

parts.description: Machined with a convex camber (crowned face) to run true and naturally self-center the belt. 391 mm outer diameter derived strictly from SolidWorks CAD geometry.
parts.safetyNotice: Critical nip point between crowned pulley and belt. Never remove protective side inspection guards while motor is energized.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: MOVING SHEAVE & BELT PINCH POINT
parts.engineeringTolerance: 391 mm OD with 3.0 mm center crown camber. Dynamic balancing ISO 1940 Grade G6.3.

parts.description: For grains, a curved aerodynamic saddle positioned beneath the head pulley guides tangential stock release directly into the discharge spout without recirculation back down the legs.
parts.safetyNotice: Wear plates under saddle must be inspected regularly for erosion or sharp burrs that cause friction ignition.
parts.hazardDecal: CAUTION: GRAIN IMPACT ABRASION & HOTSPOT ZONE
parts.engineeringTolerance: Discharge baffle clearance: 1/8" (3.18 mm) standard nominal, 1/4" (6.35 mm) max over belt lap splice. Sensor: 4B Binswitch choke detector.

parts.description: Heavy-duty abrasion-resistant steel liner plates and a flexible rubber deflector prevent grain degradation and kernel shatter from high-velocity centrifugal discharge impact.
parts.feedFlowDirection: Downwards Spout Exit to Downstream Processing
parts.safetyNotice: Ensure flexible rubber deflector is antistatic compliant to avoid electrostatic accumulation.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Baffle clearance tolerance: 1/8" (3.18 mm) standard, 1/4" (6.35 mm) over lap splice. Flush-mounted 4B Binswitch capacitance choke/plug sensor.

parts.description: Industrial electric gearmotor with flexible coupling mounted on an elevated structural head bracket. Integrated mechanical backstop prevents reverse gravitational runback of laden buckets during shutdown.
parts.feedFlowDirection: Mechanical Torque Transmission to Head Pulley Shaft
parts.safetyNotice: Strict Electrical LOTO (Padlock + Hasps + Tag) mandatory prior to any drive or coupling inspection.
parts.hazardDecal: WARNING: AUTOMATIC MECHANICAL BACKSTOP & HIGH VOLTAGE
parts.engineeringTolerance: Drive V-belt deflection formula: Deflection = Belt Span / 64 under 50N test force. Mechanical backstop instantaneous sprag locking.

parts.description: Monitors speed differential between the drive pulley and belt face (OSHA 1910.272 compliant) using a 4B M300 Slipswitch inductive underspeed sensor to immediately detect slipping and avert frictional heating.
parts.safetyNotice: Life-safety device. Automatic interlock must trip elevator motor if slip exceeds 20% or bearing temp reaches 65°C.
parts.engineeringTolerance: 4B M300 Slipswitch auto-trip at -20% nominal underspeed. Sensor target air gap: 6 mm to 10 mm off shaft target flag.

parts.description: Modular dual vertical steel casing ducts joined by perimeter angle flanges with Boone/Rolfes brass half-moon rub sensors and NFPA 68 explosion relief vents with hand-tightened relief grommets.
parts.safetyNotice: Explosion relief vents must use hand-tightened relief grommets only. Wrenches or excessive torque are strictly prohibited as they prevent blast relief.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: EXPLOSION RELIEF VENT & BRASS RUB SENSORS
parts.engineeringTolerance: Boone/Rolfes brass rub sensor thermocouple trip at 65°C. Explosion vent fastening: Hand-tightened grommets only (wrenches prohibited).

parts.description: Multi-ply polyester/polyamide fabric core with synthetic rubber cover meeting DIN 22104 standards to eliminate electrostatic spark risks in flour and grain milling zones.
parts.feedFlowDirection: Upward Linear Elevation (2.80 m/s nominal speed)
parts.safetyNotice: Never adjust belt tracking or tension while operating. Electrical continuity and antistatic conductivity must be verified quarterly.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Surface resistivity < 3 x 10^8 ohms (DIN 22104). Tensile safety factor 10:1 against full bucket stall load.

parts.description: Deep polymer/pressed steel buckets spaced at verified 300 mm (0.30 m) pitch along the 18.3 m loop, engineered for clean centrifugal discharge of wheat and maize.
parts.safetyNotice: Inspect bucket fastening bolts regularly. Detached buckets tumbling down trunking represent catastrophic mechanical collision hazard.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Pitch: 300 mm (+/- 2 mm). Grade 5 fanged elevator bolts torqued with self-locking serrated flange nuts.

parts.description: Structural steel tie frame bracing the dual elevator legs to intermediate mill floor concrete slabs at approximately Z = 5.0 m elevation to absorb lateral operational vibration.
parts.feedFlowDirection: Structural Load Transfer to Mill Building Framework
parts.safetyNotice: Ensure floor penetration fire stop seals and perimeter kickplates are maintained according to mill building safety codes.
parts.hazardDecal: NOTICE: MILL BUILDING LATERAL TIE STRUCTURE
parts.engineeringTolerance: Deflection limit < L/500 under full grain conveying harmonic load. High-tensile anchor studs.

parts.description: Sliding bearing blocks adjusted via twin vertical threaded rods on either side of the boot casing, providing precise belt tensioning and true tracking alignment.
parts.safetyNotice: Equal turns on left and right screws are mandatory to prevent belt skew and edge fraying. Tension only under locked-out conditions.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Twin screw pitch match within 1/16" (1.58 mm) across left and right sides. Minimum take-up reserve travel: 150 mm.

parts.description: Inlet feed spout directing incoming grain flow. Industry engineering rule: Material feed must enter strictly above pulley centreline on the up-leg to prevent bucket dredging and excessive boot wear.
parts.feedFlowDirection: Inward Gravity Grain Infeed (Strictly Above Pulley Centreline)
parts.safetyNotice: Inlet chute slide gate must be mechanically isolated prior to clearing any choke or entering boot area.
parts.hazardDecal: CRITICAL RULE: FEED MUST ENTER ABOVE PULLEY CL ON UP-LEG
parts.engineeringTolerance: Feed entry elevation > Z_boot_pulley + 50 mm (strictly above pulley center line on up-leg). Spout angle 38° min self-clearing slope.

parts.description: Heavy-duty inspection and cleanout access hatches secured with tool-operated fasteners for safely clearing boot chokes following full OSHA/ISO LOTO procedures.
parts.safetyNotice: CRITICAL: Never insert hands or arms to clear chokes. Use wooden or cane clearing rods only after full 11-step LOTO and belt clamping to avoid entrapment.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: SEVERE AMPUTATION HAZARD - TOOL LATCH ONLY
parts.engineeringTolerance: Captive tool-operated fastener bolts. Food-grade neoprene sponge dust seal gasket (IP65 dust rating).
